name: align-left
description: Four rounded text lines aligned left in a circle frame.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Four horizontal bars at y7.5,10.5,13.5,16.5 alternate full length9 (x7.5..16.5) and shorter length6. Short bars are left-aligned x7.5..13.5, centered x9..15 or right-aligned x10.5..16.5 according to identity. Unframed Filled is the exact Bold2.50 capsule expansion (radius1.25), like Menu/Search; framed Filled cuts out that same Bold silhouette. Regular visible bounds6.625..17.375 on each axis; Bold/Filled bounds6.25..17.75. Filled row clearance is.5px and circular clearance remains greater than.26px even when the Outline frame is Bold. All None/Square/Circle forms reuse exactly the same native glyph, with no per-frame scale or translation. Outline is Regular1.75 with round caps/joins; Thin1.25 and Bold2.50 use the same centerlines. Standard solid frame exteriors are bounds2..22, Square radius4 / Circle radius10; Outline frame centerlines are bounds2.875..21.125 with radius3.125 / circle radius9.125. Frames remain upright, with2px default outer margins. Framed Filled subtracts the exact standalone Filled silhouette as transparent negative space. All geometry is original to this project; external references establish meaning only. Native X/Y100/100, rotation0. All new forms remain draft pending owner review.

review.note: New action/alignment icon and frame variants; awaits owner review.
